# Sleek Design Mobile Apps

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a skill that turns your agent into a mobile-app design studio on top of the Sleek (sleek.design) service: it generates app screens and full UI flows from a brief and can implement Sleek designs into code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI). By @designed-by-ai (Sleek), listed here with credit to its creator. Requires a Sleek account and `SLEEK_API_KEY` in the secure vault; sustained use needs a paid Sleek plan ($49.99/month or $360/year per the skill docs). Network access is limited to sleek.design only. The skill is genuinely useful for rapid app concepting, but it is a paid-service integration, not a free design tool. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
